interpretation: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods. Pooled and donor exclude the useful margin under both methods. Uniform excludes useful advantage under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled comparisons remain unresolved at the useful margin under both methods; its uniform comparison excludes useful advantage under both. The residual pooled writer interval favors personal adaptation at zero without establishing useful advantage or surviving crossed resampling at zero. All other residual intervals include zero. Raw sums leave useful base and pooled advantage unresolved under both methods and exclude useful donor advantage under both. The raw base writer interval favors personal adaptation at zero without establishing the useful margin or surviving crossed resampling at zero. All other raw model-rival intervals include zero; raw sums are worse than uniform under both intervals.
